svg.text: Heavy work, only with a signal
The part that cannot be faked

The artisan speaks. The screen speaks back.

Signed and tied to the maker's ID.

Everything left of the dashed line runs on the phone with no network. The app never blocks on a connection, and no raw 12 MP photo ever leaves the device.
